en: A color aerial view over a mixed urban landscape: in the foreground are older, low-rise houses with red-tiled roofs and tree-lined streets, while behind them stand mid‑ and high‑rise apartment blocks typical of socialist-era architecture. In the distant background an industrial area with tall chimneys and factory buildings is visible across open fields. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with space for a stamp and address, printed captions, and credits.
